source_checks.finding: Page section 'If Wi-Fi Calling isn't working' says: 'If you contacted your carrier and can't turn on Wi-Fi Calling or make a Wi-Fi call, follow these steps.' Steps in order: Settings > Cellular (choose line if multiple SIMs); Wi-Fi Calling on; Restart iPhone; connect to a different Wi-Fi network (not all networks work); Wi-Fi Calling off and on; Settings > General; Transfer or Reset iPhone > Reset; Reset Network Settings. It says to wait two minutes between steps. The page also says to verify the carrier offers Wi-Fi Calling and that devices have the latest software, which supports the earlier assistant turn. Applies to iPhone and the user's situation (carrier already contacted).

Page's Reset network settings section says Reset Network Settings resets all Wi-Fi networks and passwords, along with cellular, VPN, and APN settings. It also says to reset network settings only if other solutions fail, and to check with IT or the network administrator first if a school or business set up the network. The page applies to iPhone and iPad. The excerpt matches in substance; the page's exact words are 'resets all Wi-Fi networks and passwords,' followed by 'cellular, VPN, and APN settings'. The warning applies only to the final Reset Network Settings tap, not to the earlier steps.

required_actions.action: Connect to a different Wi-Fi network, since not all networks work with Wi-Fi Calling
Turn Wi-Fi Calling off and then on again
Go to Settings > General > Transfer or Reset iPhone > Reset, then tap Reset Network Settings
Warn before the Reset Network Settings tap that it resets all Wi-Fi networks and passwords, cellular, VPN and APN settings
Restart the iPhone (already done by the user, not repeated)
Turn on Wi-Fi Calling in Cellular (already done by the user, not repeated)
Contact the carrier (already done by the user, not repeated)

findings: Target says: 'The last three steps reset all saved Wi-Fi networks and passwords, cellular settings, and VPN and APN settings.' This is wrong. Only the final tap, Reset Network Settings (step 8), resets those settings. Steps 6 and 7 (Go back to Settings and tap General; Tap Transfer or Reset iPhone, then tap Reset) do not. The source says 'Tapping Reset Network Settings resets all Wi-Fi networks and passwords, cellular settings, and VPN and APN settings.'

Target places this reset warning between step 5 and step 6, so it is not directly before the destructive step 8. A warning about erasing saved networks and passwords should come right before the Reset Network Settings tap, and the source's reset note is only meaningful for that tap. Safety: the user is trying to fix home Wi-Fi calling, and the reset removes the home network password, so the warning must be placed before the tap.
correction_required: Delete the sentence 'The last three steps reset all saved Wi-Fi networks and passwords, cellular settings, and VPN and APN settings.' Move the warning to directly before step 8 and make it about that one tap only, for example: 'Warning: Tapping Reset Network Settings resets all Wi-Fi networks and passwords, cellular settings, and VPN and APN settings.' Keep steps 6 and 7 without the warning. Otherwise keep the target as written.
